description: Search willhaben.at for second-hand listings and rank the underpriced ones
name: io.github.taneron/willmehr

environmentVariables.description: 'full' (default) registers the account tools; 'public' runs anonymously, reads no credential and paces requests for a shared IP.
environmentVariables.name: WILLMEHR_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Session cookie from a logged-in willhaben browser session, needed only by the willhaben_my_* tools. Must contain BBX_JSESSIONID and x-bbx-csrf-token. Sessions expire within roughly half an hour.
environmentVariables.name: WILLHABEN_COOKIE

environmentVariables.description: Minimum spacing between requests to willhaben, in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: WILLHABEN_MIN_INTERVAL_MS

title: willmehr
